why: a template literal is a string concatenation with ToString on each hole: greet puts the age in parentheses (unproved, WITNESS); badge spells the boolean hole as the two string literals under a test of the field (proved: a boolean hole is its name); years writes the age plus zero (proved: ToString of a number is a function of the number alone); handle is untouched, its hole a field that may be missing, read as "undefined" when it is; stamp splits the template into concatenations and writes the number literal 10 as its string (proved).
